invariants.name: interval_xor_reduction
invariants.description: The XOR of all substrings of length K reduces to the XOR of a fixed continuous segment of the original string for each output bit. Bit i of the result T is exactly the XOR of the bits of S with indices from i to i + N - K, leveraging the equivalence that XOR over many aligned substrings collapses to a single interval XOR due to cancellation and duplication properties.
